articles.summary: -- Global, first-in-human study underway designed to evaluate safety, tolerability, and initial clinical efficacy of PM577a -- -- PM577a is designed as a one-time therapy to correct the H1069Q mutation in ATP7B, the most prevalent Wilson disease-causing mutation in North America and Europe‌ -- --
articles.title: Prime Medicine Announces First Patient Dosed in Global Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of PM577a for H1069Q-Mutated Wilson Disease
